name: Issue 1042: Power Overwhelming lets Runeblade and Primordial Blast reset every rank of Runic Brand
contract: Power Overwhelming 707876 (Runic specialization, level 40 passive) reads 'Your Runeblade and Primordial Blast
now have a $h% (ProcChance 35) chance to grant you Power Overwhelming, resetting the cooldown of Runic Brand.'
Effect 0 is aura 42 triggering 560051 (the crit buff Branded 707717 lengthens) and effect 1 aura 42 triggering
561055, SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN on Runic Brand's first rank 712299 by -12000 ms, its whole 12 sec
cooldown. Spell.dbc gives 707876 ProcFlags 0, so SpellMgr generated no proc entry and neither effect ever fired.
Runic Brand ranks share category 2074, so casting rank 4 712303 cools every rank; a reset of 712299 alone would
leave 712303 unusable. Runeblade is the only family 38 spell with mask2 0x40000, Primordial Blast carries mask1
0x100000. Runic Brand deals its damage 'with each weapon' and carries SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_OFF_HAND_WEAPON, so
both Runemasters dual wield. Expected: each trial casts Runic Brand, then Runeblade, then Runic Brand again
2.6 sec after the first, well inside its 12 sec cooldown, so the second cast lands only when that Runeblade reset
the cooldown. Thirty trials at 35% give 1 to 23 resets outside a 3e-6 tail, and as many extra Runic Brands; a
Runemaster without the talent never resets and casts exactly one Runic Brand per trial. Thirty Primordial Blasts
